en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Dukadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (6) 18.7.
Hetuduka, Mahantaradukādi

Dependent on a cause-conditioned phenomenon that has an object, there arises a non-cause, non-object-conditioned phenomenon by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a non-cause, non-object-conditioned phenomenon, there arises a non-non-cause, non-non-object-conditioned phenomenon by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under object condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
Dependent on a rootless non-mental state, a non-root non-mental state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a root non-mental state, a non-root non-non-mental state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a root mental state, a non-root non-mental state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a rootless non-mental-factor dhamma, there arises a rootless non-mental-factor dhamma by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a root dhamma associated with consciousness, there arises a non-root dhamma not associated with consciousness by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root, three under predominance; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root state dissociated from consciousness, there arises a non-root, non-consciousness-dissociated state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: three; under object: three ... pe ... under non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a root state associated with consciousness, there arises a non-root, non-consciousness-associated state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: three; under predominance: three ... pe ... under non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a rootless state dissociated from consciousness, there arises a rootless state not dissociated from consciousness by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root [condition] there are three; under the object [condition] there are three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance [condition] there are three.

Dependent on a root state originated by consciousness, there arises a non-root state not originated by consciousness by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root [condition] there are three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance [condition] there are three.

Dependent on a non-root, non-mentally-originated state, there arises a non-root, non-mentally-originated state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a root, mind-concomitant state, there arises a non-root, non-mind-concomitant state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root dhamma that is not co-existent with consciousness, there arises a non-root dhamma that is not co-existent with consciousness by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a root dhamma that is concomitant with consciousness, there arises a non-root dhamma that is not concomitant with consciousness by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor concomitant with consciousness, there arises a state that is neither a root-cause nor concomitant with consciousness by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition, three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a state that is a root-cause and conjoined-with-and-produced-by-consciousness, there arises a state that is not a root-cause and not conjoined-with-and-produced-by-consciousness by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition, three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a rootless state that is neither associated with nor produced by consciousness, there arises a state that is rootless and neither associated with nor produced by consciousness, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under the root [condition] … pe … three under the non-disappearance [condition].

Dependent on a rootless state that is associated with and co-existent with consciousness, there arises a state that is not a root and is neither associated with nor co-existent with consciousness, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under the root [condition] … pe … three under the non-disappearance [condition].

Dependent on a non-root dhamma that is not conjoined with, not produced by, and not co-existent with consciousness, there arises a non-root dhamma that is not conjoined with, not produced by, and not co-existent with consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a root dhamma that is conjoined with, produced by, and follows upon consciousness, there arises a non-root dhamma that is not conjoined with, not produced by, and does not follow upon consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not-root-cause, not associated with consciousness, and not co-nascent, there arises a state that is not-root-cause, not associated with consciousness, and not co-nascent, by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
